# Forecourt MS

> Forecourt Management System — a multi-branch web application for managing petrol station operations across Liberia (tanks, pumps, shifts, deliveries, HR, and financials).

Forecourt MS is a private, authenticated operations platform for petroleum retailers. Most functionality lives behind sign-in; the public surface is limited to the marketing landing page and the login screen.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point to sign in.
- [Sign in](/login): Authentication for admins, supervisors, dealers, cashiers, and attendants.
